title: The finite-stage colimit of bounded finite-dimensional derived categories
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $\Qlb$ an algebraic closure of $\Ql$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and $\mathcal E_\ell$ the directed set of finite extensions $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. For $E\in\mathcal E_\ell$ let $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)\subset D(E)$ be the category of [def-weil-point-fd-complexes]. For $E\subset L$ in $\mathcal E_\ell$ let $T_{L/E}:D(E)\to D(L)$, $M\mapsto M\otimes_EL$, be termwise scalar extension: $L$ is a free $E$-module of finite rank, so the termwise tensor product is exact, preserves quasi-isomorphisms and induces a functor of derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $H^i(M\otimes_EL)=H^i(M)\otimes_EL$; hence $T_{L/E}$ maps $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ into $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)$. For $E\subset L\subset M$ the canonical isomorphisms of complexes $(N\otimes_EL)\otimes_LM\cong N\otimes_EM$ identify $T_{M/L}T_{L/E}$ with $T_{M/E}$.

Define the category $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ as follows. Its objects are pairs $(E,M)$ with $E\in\mathcal E_\ell$ and $M\in D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$. Its morphisms are

$$
 \operatorname{Hom}((E,M),(E',M'))=\varinjlim_{\substack{L\in\mathcal E_\ell\\L\supset E,E'}}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(L)}\bigl(M\otimes_EL,\,M'\otimes_{E'}L\bigr),
$$

the directed colimit of abelian groups [def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups] whose transition map for $L\subset L'$ sends $u$ to $u\otimes_LL'$ composed with the canonical isomorphisms above. Composition of $[L,u]$ and $[L',v]$ is the class of $v_M\circ u_M$, where $M\supset L,L'$ is a common upper bound and $u_M,v_M$ are the transported representatives. The shift is $(E,M)[1]=(E,M[1])$, and a triangle is distinguished when it is isomorphic to the image of a distinguished triangle of $D(L)$ whose three objects lie in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)$, for some $L\in\mathcal E_\ell$. This is the blueprint's $\operatorname{2-colim}_{E\in\mathcal E_\ell}D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$; it is formed exactly as the common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], with the stages $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ in place of $D^b_c(Y,E)$.

source.place: the display defining $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ as a 2-colimit in the statement
